clientMeta.name: Alex Mercer
clientMeta.notes: Prioritize Shoulder Mobility & Ankle Dorsiflexion drills in warm-up before main lower/upper lifts. Leave 2 reps in reserve (RPE 8) on primary compound sets.

fmsComments: Left shoulder internal rotation deficit noted during Shoulder Mobility screen; keep overhead barbell/DB pressing restricted until score reaches >= 2. Re-test in 4 weeks.

exerciseLibrary.name: Band Shoulder Dislocators
exerciseLibrary.cues: Use a wide grip on a light resistance band or PVC pipe. Keep ribs tucked down and move smoothly overhead without lumbar hyperextension.

exerciseLibrary.name: Banded Overhead Lat Stretch
exerciseLibrary.cues: Anchor band high, hinge hips back, keep thumb pointed up, and breathe deeply into the posterior ribcage for 30-45s per side.

exerciseLibrary.name: Floor Slide with Diaphragmatic Breathing
exerciseLibrary.cues: Lie supine with knees bent and lower back gently pressed to floor. Slide forearms overhead only as far as wrists and elbows stay grounded.

exerciseLibrary.name: Kettlebell Arm Bar
exerciseLibrary.cues: Press light KB vertically, roll onto side/hip while keeping eyes on bell and shoulder packed away from ear. Hold 20-30s.

exerciseLibrary.name: Prone YTWL
exerciseLibrary.cues: Lie prone with forehead supported. Lift thumbs toward ceiling in Y, T, W, and L positions with 2-second isometric pause.

exerciseLibrary.name: Quadruped T-Spine Rotation
exerciseLibrary.cues: Sit hips back toward heels to lock lumbar spine. Place hand behind head and rotate elbow toward ceiling while exhaling.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bretzel Stretch
exerciseLibrary.cues: Side-lying position: hold top knee down with bottom hand, grab bottom ankle with top hand, and rotate upper shoulder toward floor.

exerciseLibrary.name: Half-Kneeling Landmine Press
exerciseLibrary.cues: Down-knee directly under hip, squeeze glute, brace core, and press landmine arc overhead without flaring ribs.

exerciseLibrary.name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Row
exerciseLibrary.cues: Support on bench with neutral spine. Pull elbow toward hip pocket, avoiding anterior shoulder roll at top.

exerciseLibrary.name: Kettlebell Halo
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold KB upside down by horns. Orbit closely around head while keeping ribcage stacked over pelvis.

exerciseLibrary.name: Half-Kneeling Cable Pulldown
exerciseLibrary.cues: Tall posture in half-kneeling stance. Drive elbows down and back, finishing with forearms vertical.

exerciseLibrary.name: Ankle Band Distraction Mobilization
exerciseLibrary.cues: Place heavy band low across talus bone. Drive knee forward over 2nd/3rd toe while keeping heel planted.

exerciseLibrary.name: Half-Kneeling Ankle Dorsiflexion
exerciseLibrary.cues: In half-kneeling, rock knee past toes without heel lift. Hold end range for 3 seconds per rep.

exerciseLibrary.name: Pole/TRX Assisted Deep Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold TRX straps or vertical pole for counterbalance. Sit straight down between heels with chest proud.

exerciseLibrary.name: Assisted Squat with Dowel
exerciseLibrary.cues: Press dowel firmly into floor in front of feet to engage anterior core while descending into full depth.

exerciseLibrary.name: Deep Squat Hold with T-Spine Rotation
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold bottom of bodyweight squat (heels elevated on wedge if needed). Anchor one elbow inside knee and reach opposite arm skyward.

exerciseLibrary.name: Quad Rocking with Dorsiflexion
exerciseLibrary.cues: Start on hands and knees with toes tucked under. Rock hips smoothly back toward heels while maintaining neutral lumbar curve.

exerciseLibrary.name: Landmine Box Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold landmine at chest for anterior counterbalance. Sit back to box with control, pause without relaxing, and drive up.

exerciseLibrary.name: Kettlebell Goblet Squat with Curl
exerciseLibrary.cues: At bottom of goblet squat, perform a controlled bicep curl to reinforce upright torso and hip mobility before standing.

exerciseLibrary.name: Goblet Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold DB/KB tight to sternum, elbows tucked. Pull yourself down between knees and drive evenly through whole foot.

exerciseLibrary.name: Barbell Back Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Brace 360 degrees before unracking. Control descent to parallel or below while keeping knees tracking over toes.

exerciseLibrary.name: Dowel Overhead Deep Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Press PVC dowel overhead with active shoulders. Descend into full squat keeping dowel aligned over mid-foot.

exerciseLibrary.name: Hurdle Step Over Dowel
exerciseLibrary.cues: Set hurdle string just below tibial tuberosity. Stand tall on stance leg, step over cleanly without hip hike or trunk lean.

exerciseLibrary.name: Cook Hip Lift
exerciseLibrary.cues: Supine, hug one knee tightly to chest (pinning tennis ball) to lock pelvis. Drive opposite heel to extend hip fully.

exerciseLibrary.name: Heel-Elevated Glute Bridge
exerciseLibrary.cues: Place heels on low box/bench. Exhale ribs down, posterior pelvic tilt, and lift hips using hamstrings and glutes.

exerciseLibrary.name: Assisted 1-Leg Glute Bridge with Band Kick
exerciseLibrary.cues: Loop mini-band around feet. Hold one knee up in flexion while bridging on stance leg to build pelvic dissociation.

exerciseLibrary.name: Landmine Assisted Single-Leg RDL
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold landmine end in opposite hand of stance leg. Hinge hips back with soft knee and square pelvis.

exerciseLibrary.name: Single-Leg Box Step-Up
exerciseLibrary.cues: Drive through full stance foot on 12-16" box without pushing off trailing toes. Control 3-second eccentric down.

exerciseLibrary.name: Marching Farmer Carry
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold heavy DBs/KBs at sides. March slowly with 2-second knee-up pause, avoiding lateral pelvic drop.

exerciseLibrary.name: Half-Kneeling Hip Flexor Stretch
exerciseLibrary.cues: 90/90 stance. Tuck tailbone under (posterior tilt) and squeeze rear glute until stretch is felt in front of hip.

exerciseLibrary.name: Couch Stretch
exerciseLibrary.cues: Rear shin vertical against wall/bench, front foot planted. Maintain braced abs and upright torso.

exerciseLibrary.name: Assisted Reverse Lunge
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold TRX straps or rack lightly for balance. Step back softly, kiss back knee to pad, and drive up through front heel.

exerciseLibrary.name: Landmine Split Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hold landmine at chest in split stance. Drop straight down with vertical shin and balanced weight distribution.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exerciseLibrary.cues: Rear laces resting on bench. Hinge slightly forward at torso and descend smoothly with stable front knee.

exerciseLibrary.name: Dumbbell Walking Lunge
exerciseLibrary.cues: Take controlled stride lengths, keeping front knee aligned with toes and torso tall through each step.

exerciseLibrary.name: Active Hamstring Stretch with Strap
exerciseLibrary.cues: Supine with strap around arch. Keep opposite leg pressed flat into floor with toes pulled up while raising strapped leg.

exerciseLibrary.name: Active Straight Leg Raise with Band Assist
exerciseLibrary.cues: Anchor light band to top foot for assistance. Exhale fully to engage anterior core while lowering opposite leg slowly.

exerciseLibrary.name: Leg Lowering with Dowel
exerciseLibrary.cues: Press hands into dowel held vertically over chest while keeping both legs straight and lowering one heel at a time.

exerciseLibrary.name: Romanian Deadlift (RDL)
exerciseLibrary.cues: Soft knee bend, push hips straight back until hamstrings reach full tension, keeping barbell/DBs shaving thighs.

exerciseLibrary.name: Trap Bar Deadlift
exerciseLibrary.cues: Center inside handles, wedge hips down with flat back, push floor away and finish tall with glutes.

exerciseLibrary.name: Kettlebell Swing
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hike bell high into groin, snap hips forward forcefully to float bell to chest height without leaning back.

exerciseLibrary.name: Crocodile Breathing
exerciseLibrary.cues: Lie prone with forehead on hands. Inhale 360 degrees into belly and lower back, expanding ribs laterally.

exerciseLibrary.name: Incline Push-Up
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hands elevated on bench/barbell at height allowing rigid plank from head to heels. Lower chest to edge with elbows at 45 degrees.

exerciseLibrary.name: High Plank Shoulder Tap
exerciseLibrary.cues: Feet wider than shoulders. Tap opposite shoulder slowly without letting hips sway or lower back sag.

exerciseLibrary.name: Push-Up
exerciseLibrary.cues: Move body as one rigid unit. Chest touches floor first, screw hands into ground to press back up.

exerciseLibrary.name: Front Plank (RKC Style)
exerciseLibrary.cues: Pull elbows toward toes and squeeze glutes/quads maximally for 15-20s high-tension bouts.

exerciseLibrary.name: Barbell Bench Press
exerciseLibrary.cues: Set upper back arch, plant feet firmly, lower bar to mid-chest with forearms vertical, press smoothly.

exerciseLibrary.name: Hard Rolling
exerciseLibrary.cues: Supine with arms/legs extended. Initiate upper-body roll using only eyes, head, and arm reach—keep lower body completely dead weight.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bird Dog
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hands under shoulders, knees under hips. Extend opposite arm and heel long without shifting pelvis or overarching lumbar spine.

exerciseLibrary.name: Bear Crawl Hold
exerciseLibrary.cues: Hover knees 1 inch off floor with flat back (balance foam roller on lumbar). Breathe steadily for 20-30s.

exerciseLibrary.name: Half-Kneeling Pallof Press
exerciseLibrary.cues: In 90/90 stance, press cable/band straight out from sternum and hold 2 seconds against lateral pull.

exerciseLibrary.name: Standing Pallof Press
exerciseLibrary.cues: Athletic quarter-squat stance. Press handle out without torso twist; control return to chest.

exerciseLibrary.name: Suitcase Carry
exerciseLibrary.cues: Carry single heavy KB/DB on one side. Walk tall without leaning toward or away from the load.
